title: Patterns in a new text
instructions: Read the whole text, then choose the set of words for all three gaps.

parts.prompt: Dimas congratulated his sister ___ winning the prize. He was proud ___ her, and he offered ___ carry the trophy home.

choice_rationales.A: Proud does not pair with to, and offer is not followed by at.
choice_rationales.B: Congratulate does not pair with at, and offer is not followed by by.
choice_rationales.C: Congratulate does not pair with to, and proud does not pair with with.
choice_rationales.D: Congratulate on, proud of and offer to are the usual patterns.

parts.hint: Check each gap on its own, then read the text again.
parts.correct_explanation: The three patterns are congratulate on, proud of and offer to.
